Package com.recruitment.util

Class ShadowBorder

java.lang.Object
com.recruitment.util.ShadowBorder
All Implemented Interfaces:
Border
public class ShadowBorder extends Object implements Border
Custom Border that paints a multi-layer soft drop shadow beneath a rounded card panel, producing a Material Design / spatial UI elevation effect without third-party dependencies.

The host component must call setOpaque(false) so the shadow painted in the border insets is visible around the card.

Usage example: 


 panel.setOpaque(false);
 panel.setBorder(new ShadowBorder(12, 4));

      public ShadowBorder(int cornerRadius, int shadowSize)
      Creates a shadow border with default offset, shadow tint, and white card background.
      Parameters:
      cornerRadius - arc radius for the rounded rectangle card

    • ShadowBorder

      public ShadowBorder(int cornerRadius, int shadowSize, int shadowOffset, Color shadowColor, Color cardBackground)
      Creates a fully customised shadow border.
      Parameters:
      cornerRadius - arc radius for the rounded card
      shadowSize - number of shadow gradient layers
      shadowOffset - vertical offset of the shadow stack
      shadowColor - base colour for shadow layers
      cardBackground - fill colour for the card interior
